<function name="Droppable" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>

Can be called multiple times with different names allowing to be dropped onto different receivers.
	</description>

	</args>

		<ret name="" type="table">Blank table stored on the panel itself under pnl.m_DragSlot[ name ]. Is reset every time this function is called and does not appear to be used or exposed anywhere else.</ret>

</function>
